In just a few years, AI technology's impact on the film and television industry has extended from post-production special effects to front-end filming, and while improving efficiency and reducing costs, it has accelerated the erosion of real actors' performance space and disrupted the underlying logic of the film and television industry
在技术层面，视频生成大模型飞速迭代，解决了早期虚拟表演僵硬、违和等痛点，可以精准: At the technical level, video generation large models are iterating rapidly, resolving early issues of rigid and jarring virtual performances, and can accurately replicate actors' micro-expressions, physical details, and tone of voice, to some extent reducing production crews' reliance on real actors
据统计，今年第一季度上线的微短剧，AI生成内容占比超过95%，但核心播放量仅占4: According to statistics, for micro short dramas launched in the first quarter of this year, AI-generated content accounts for over 95%, yet core playback volume only represents 4%
这意味着，即便AI演员“抢”走了部分片约，绝大部分观众还是用点击量投了真人演员一: This means that even if AI actors "snatch" some roles, the vast majority of viewers still cast their votes for real actors through clicks
可以看出，AI要淘汰的是僵化、浅表、缺乏内涵的表演套路和陈旧粗糙、重复低效的生产: It is clear that AI aims to eliminate rigid, superficial, and uninspired performance routines and outdated, crude, and repetitive inefficient production modes, rather than the profession of acting itself, let alone the performing arts industry
一部分演员选择回归话剧舞台，在日复一日的现场反馈中锤炼表演的精度与厚度，也有演员: Some actors have chosen to return to the stage theater, honing the precision and depth of their performances through daily live feedback, while others have opted to transition to content production in collaboration with AI, expanding their professional horizons
目前，司法机关、有关部门与行业组织已经采取措施，打击AI短剧非法“换脸”等侵权行: Currently, judicial authorities, relevant departments, and industry organizations have taken measures to crack down on illegal AI short drama "deepfakes" and other infringement activities, while also promoting normalized full-network infringement monitoring, notarized evidence preservation, and batch rights protection to build more robust safeguards for actors' rights and interests
如今，面对AI的飞速发展，演员行业乃至整个文艺领域更需要坚守人在创作中的主体地位: Today, in the face of AI's rapid development, the acting profession and the entire cultural and artistic field need more than ever to uphold the protagonist status of humans in creation, pursuing expressions with greater humanistic warmth and performances with more vivid life texture
AI不会淘汰好演员，只会逼出“真演技”: AI will not eliminate good actors, it will only drive out "true acting skills"
